summary: Iteration 5: full backend + frontend regression + validation of the new business rules (purchase-by-total-nominal with auto estimation, Paha Ayam byproduct, per-pcs sales for byproducts, 'Produksi Potong' rename). 27/27 backend pytest PASS, 5/5 frontend flows PASS. End-to-end pcs sale (2 pcs Paha Ayam @ Rp 8.000 = Rp 16.000) completed and visible in Riwayat as Selesai.
critical_code_review_comments: Purchases.js/Production.js still use Math.random() for row _k stable keys — safe but crypto.randomUUID() would be cleaner (already noted in iter 4).

server.py create_purchase: division-by-zero guards exist for total_weight_all/total_ekor_all/total_bird_value, but if a purchase item has ekor=0 & total_weight>0 the per-item hpp_ekor becomes 0 silently — consider surfacing a warning or requiring both.

Dashboard products_perf ignores 'pcs' unit qty aggregation (only weight & ekor buckets) — pcs sales still contribute penjualan/hpp/laba correctly, but weight/ekor per-category counters exclude pcs volume. Minor reporting gap.

cancel_sale does not restore pcs stock — only handles ekor/kg deltas (server.py L602-608). If a pcs-unit sale is later cancelled, the pcs stock will NOT be returned. Bug — needs `d_pcs = it['qty'] if it['unit']=='pcs' else 0` and pass `delta_pcs=d_pcs` to apply_stock.
test_credentials: Owner shezrofenia18@gmail.com / berkahayam1, Kasir kasir@berkahayam.com / kasir123, Admin admin@berkahayam.com / admin123, Operator operator@berkahayam.com / operator123 — all verified.
seed_data_creation: 1 real POS pcs sale (2 pcs Paha Ayam @ 8000 = Rp 16.000) created via UI. 1 purchase via API (ekor=10, weight=15kg, total_price=450k, transport=20k -> total_modal=470k, buy_price_kg=30k). Test-prefixed customers/suppliers cleaned up per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (27 tests, run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` for serial). Parallel xdist may cause stock-based race asserts in Sale/Operations classes; use -n 0 for reliable numeric checks. New tests added: test_paha_ayam_product_exists (units include kg+pcs, both prices >0), test_sale_pcs_unit_decrements_pcs_stock (verifies pcs stock decrements, kg stock unchanged), and updated test_create_purchase to send total_price instead of buy_price_kg with assertion that server-computed buy_price_kg = total_price/total_weight (30000). Frontend verified: Owner routes to /dashboard, Kasir routes to /pos, PurchaseDialog shows 'Perkiraan Harga/kg' + 'Modal Efektif/ekor' auto rows (no manual buy_price_kg input), Production page + nav shows 'Produksi Potong' (no 'Produksi Fillet'), Paha Ayam product renders in POS with unit-kg + unit-pcs toggle (price_pcs=8000, price_kg=32000), pcs sale creates Selesai entry Rp 16.000 in Riwayat. Zero page errors.

test_results.purchase_dialog_new_business_rules: PASS (Total Rp input, Perkiraan Harga/kg + Modal Efektif/ekor auto-rows)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the requested feature scope. The one latent bug flagged in code review (cancel_sale does not restore pcs stock) is out-of-scope of this iteration's explicit test list but should be addressed by main agent: server.py cancel_sale loop must include `d_pcs = it['qty'] if it['unit']=='pcs' else 0` and pass `delta_pcs=d_pcs` to apply_stock. Currently a pcs-unit cancelled sale silently loses inventory recovery.
